pillMark.note: Phiegg's mark: a Phi-Pill stem with its pill cut out and two wings, leant; one flat shape, filled even-odd in the text's colour. Drawn by scripts/logo-mark.py from scripts/logo-mark.tsv, which also writes the files.

sIcon.note: the Phiegg S icon: Phiogy's mark in mirror, upright a bar holding a long pill and a square cut in half (one half each side, each keeping half the square's counter), turned 45 degrees; straight runs and arcs fitted to the user's drawing (public/logo/phiegg-icon-drawing.png) by scripts/logo-bar-icon.py, which also writes these parts. Drawn in Phi-Pill's layers: depth (the outline and holes swept down and right by `depth`), face, and the pill laid in light.
sIcon.tuned: over the fit, by the user, with radii and wall widths only: a circular top and bottom (the bar's top corner and the piece's round corner each half the top edge, r_bar=r_round=20.5; h_round=12), rounder points (r_tip=10, the counters' tip corner 6.5 to keep the wall), taller half-counters (c_top=8, c_cut=3.5), and the thin wall swapped between the halves so the mark is not the same after a half turn: the top hook's middle wall (pill to counter) as thin as the pill, its outer wall thick (t_in=3.7, t_out=9.6); the bottom hook the opposite, thick middle, outer wall as thin as the pill (c_out=6.4). Rerun: scripts/logo-bar-icon.py public/logo/phiegg-icon-drawing.png public/logo r_bar=20.5 r_round=20.5 h_round=12 r_tip=10 h_tip=6.5 c_top=8 c_cut=3.5 c_out=6.4 t_in=3.7 t_out=9.6

colourways.note: from scripts/logo-bar-icon.tsv; the two-colour one is cut down the pill, one hook each colour

brand.name: phiegg

egg.source: the original Phiegg mark (git 34080b3): egg and cone stroked 11 wide with round joins, turned 30 degrees; its oval holds the bird (scripts/logo-trace.py --egg) where the pill was; the parting between cone and egg is drawn at egg.parting of the stroke, thinned from the cone side

thin.note: the wall is thinner where the turned mark faces up and left (the triangle top arm, the egg top-left); the right side keeps the full stroke

brand.iconSource: public/logo/phiegg-bird-wing-alone-wing-eye.png (the final bird: spread wing, gem eye, facing right, drawn at its own size), traced by scripts/logo-bird.py (eye kept soft, tail tips cut soft) and set by scripts/logo-trace.py --frame --place --path on the box of the wing bird in public/logo/phiegg-3d-with-bird-wing.png, in the egg of public/logo/phiegg-3d-with-bird-no-touch.png
brand.markSource: the p of the phiegg wordmark (public/logo/phiegg-3d.svg) shaped by brand.icon, its face, height 88 of the 100 box

merch.note: the Phiegg bird for merchandise: each item in each colour, as SVG and as a transparent PNG (scripts/logo-merch.mjs)

birdSet.note: bird designs to choose from: one body kept in place (the 0-100 box of the bird-alone files, facing right), parts added or cut; each on a squarish tile shaded like the header pin (scripts/logo-bird-set.mjs)

tile.note: the header pin square: 9px inset and 4px corners on 40.5px, shaded left to right; lift is how much lighter the left edge is

media.note: icons for media (avatars, posts, stores): the bird inside a frame drawn from the brand's own shapes, and the EGG token sign built like the pound sign, all from scripts/logo-media.py; the colours and PNGs from scripts/logo-merch.mjs media
media.gapNote: the room between the bird and its frame's inside, a share of the inside's width: the egg mark's own (the bird 31 px from a hole 567 px wide)

phiegg-eye.note: the bird's own eye: its outer edge and its diamond, the bird where the diamond was

phiegg-square.note: Phifing 4's 8: its lower bowl, the outside's bottom mirrored to close the top, the bird in its square

phiegg-egg.note: the egg mark with the bird, as the header and favicon draw it

token.note: the EGG sign: Phifing 4's capital E made like the pound sign, from the pound's own parts: its bar through the E's back, its curl and foot at the E's bottom

egg-sign-capital-e.note: the pound's bar through the E's back, running on into its middle arm

egg-sign-foot.note: the pound's curl and foot behind the E's back; the E's own bottom arm

egg-sign-foot-bar.note: the pound's foot behind the back, and its bar through the back into the arm

egg-sign-base.note: the pound's whole bottom (curl and foot, its own length) under the E's top and arm

egg-sign-base-bar.note: the pound's whole bottom and its bar through the back: the pound with the E's top

token.nameNote: file names are lower case: Windows keeps E and e as one name

profileTabIcons._: The glyph on each profile tab (lucide names).

profileRail._: A profile's status row: its story sets, then its own posts, so the row never shows fewer than min.

layouts._: The layouts a grid section can switch between (lucide icons); they set the app's list view.
layouts.label: Layout

worldTabs._: A world's page: the sections it shows, in order. `tab` puts one in the row of tabs under the name (the others are reached from the right sidebar's Center); `of` makes one section of several of the city's (CityParts), each under its own name; `own` is the page's own (status: its figures and what you can do there; views: the city's views as slides). A section with nothing in it is left out.

worldMenu._: A city's full-screen menu (the vertical rail at the left), by the section each entry goes to; only the sections the city has show.

postMenu._: A post's menu, the first column of its sheet: 4-6 letter words; an entry with a section shows when that section is on the sheet (the post's Info, Chat and Links, its city's Views, Zones, Posts, PFTs, Hosts...), one with an action when it can act (PostPage).

kindCards._: Each kind's related cards: the shape of the picture and whether its row slides (else a grid of three). A record related alone joins the strip of single records instead.

relationNames._: Each relation's heading: one word of four to six letters (a relation's own name in lib/relations.ts can be a phrase); a name not listed must already be one.
relationNames.Creator: Maker

kindLabels._: What a record of each kind is called, as a related set (Connected, the relation tabs).

kindIcons._: The glyph of each kind (lucide names), on its relation tab and heading.

_hostPeople: How many people a host's page lists down its side.

sectionIcons._: The glyph before a page section's title, by section id (lucide names); a section with none shows its title alone.

typeNames._: What a type of record is called where it is named in a line (a template's steps, an item's type).
typeNames.title: Title
